Lesson 10. Pitch Notation

Notes are placed on the lines and in the spaces of the staff according to their pitch. Pitch refers to how high or low a note sounds. Notes higher on the staff sound higher in pitch. Notes lower on the staff sound lower in pitch, as shown below. The highest and lowest notes on the staff below are labeled. Listen to these low notes and high notes on track 21.

H L

Ledger Lines If the pitch is very high or very low, the staff can be extended using ledger lines. These are used for notes outside of the staff's range. Ledger Line

Ledger Line

Practice

1. Mark the highest and lowest note on the staff with “H” and “L.”
